summary: Frontend E2E for iter175 additions: ticket fare badge per line, Bus vs VTC comparison card (temps + prix), book-vtc button, continue-vtc CTA, admin line-fare field. All targeted selectors and flows pass.
critical_code_review_comments: TransportPublicPage.toggleCompare uses raw fetch + credentials:'include' instead of services/api axios client. Works but bypasses any shared interceptors/auth-refresh logic; consider exposing a rides.estimate() helper for consistency.

Verdict logic mixes time-saving and price-cheaper branches: when busMin === vtc.duration_mins, the message falls through to 'le bus reste 0 € moins cher' which is awkward; consider a third 'égalité' branch.
AdminTransport line-fare input is text/number HTML; backend accepts a numeric/null but no client-side range validation (negative tariff allowed). Low priority.
